source.questions:
Casey says everyone shares their location. Is that normal?
And what about when I went out with my friends?

output.answer: Some couples do share locations, usually well into a relationship and by choice on both sides. That is not what happened here. [MATCH] asked for your location whenever you are out, and when you said you were not comfortable, answered with "everyone does it" instead of letting it go. The next night they asked who you were with just before midnight. Asking to keep track of where you are, and pressing after a no, is the part worth taking seriously, whatever other people do. You were right to say no.
